text: US licensed product information does not recommend its use during breast feeding. For a discussion of the use of loratadine in breast feeding, see under Adverse Effects and Precautions, p.583. Pregnancy. Desloratadine was not teratogenic in animal stud- ies; however, product information recommends it should be used with caution, if at all, in pregnant women. For a discussion of the use of loratadine in pregnancy, see under Adverse Effects and Precautions, p.583.
